_howto: HOW TO ADD A RIDER: add an object to 'shoutouts':
Put a small square avatar image in the repo at that path (webp preferred, ~160px).
Set "enabled": true to show the section. While enabled is false the whole
section stays hidden on the live site — safe to stage entries here first.
Push to main; the site deploys automatically.
